description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the SearchByName operation, which is used to query image information in an Image Search instance by name
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchByName接口的语法及示例，用于根据名称查询图像搜索实例中的图片信息
name: SearchImageByName

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure you distinguish between them
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The product category. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
For product image search, if you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category from the response.
<props="china">
For fabric, trademark, generic, home furnishing, and industrial hardware searches, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
<props="intl">
For generic image search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
商品类目。具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
对于商品搜索，如果设置类目，则以设置的为准；如果不设置类目，则由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可以在Response中获取 。
<props="china">
对于布料、商标、通用、家具家居和工业五金搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
<props="intl">
对于通用搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。</props>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~100。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The start position of the results to return. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. The int_attr field supports the following operators: in, not in, greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), and equal to (=). The str_attr field supports the following operators: in, not in, equal to (=), and not equal to (!=). Multiple conditions can be connected by using AND and OR.
Examples:
int_attr>=100.
str_attr!="value1".
int_attr=1000 AND str_attr="value1".

The maximum length is 4,096 characters
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有in、not in、等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
int_attr>=100。
str_attr!="value1"。
int_attr=1000 AND str_attr="value1"。

最多支持4096个字符
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deduplicate results based on ProductId.
Set this parameter to true to enable deduplication
parameters.help_zh:
根据ProductId进行去重复数据。
设置为true则有效
parameters.name: distinct_product_id

parameters.help_en: The similarity score threshold. If you specify this parameter, only images with a similarity score greater than or equal to the threshold are returned. Valid values: 0.00 to 1.00. Up to two decimal places are supported. Default value: 0.00
parameters.help_zh: 填写相似度分数阈值后，只返回图片相似度分数大于等于阈值的图片信息。阈值范围0.00-1.00，最大支持2位小数，默认为0.00
parameters.name: score_threshold

Auctions.description_en: The descriptions of all returned products
Auctions.description_zh: 所有返回的商品描述信息

CustomContent.description_en: The custom content defined by the user

IntAttr3.description_en: The integer attribute. This field can be used for filtering during queries and is returned in query results
IntAttr3.description_zh: 整数类型属性，可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段

IntAttr4.description_en: The integer attribute. This field can be used for filtering during queries and is returned in query results
IntAttr4.description_zh: 整数类型属性，可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段

Score.description_en:
The image similarity score. Valid values: 0 to 1.
You must upgrade to V3.1.1 or later to use this field
Score.description_zh:
图片相似打分。取值范围：0~1。
需要版本升级至V3.1.1方可使用

SortExprValues.description_en:
The system scoring information.
This field is deprecated. Use Score instead.
SortExprValues is a semicolon-separated pair. The first value indicates the relevance score of the image. A higher value indicates higher relevance to the query image. The scoring varies depending on the algorithm model.
When the category is 0 to 2, the value range of SortExprValues is 0 to 7.33136443711219e+24.
For other category values, the value range of SortExprValues is 0 to 5.37633353624177e+24. This score reaches its maximum when two images are identical
SortExprValues.description_zh:
系统打分信息。
当前字段已弃用，建议使用Score。
SortExprValues是一个分号分隔的二元组，第一个值表示图片的相关性分数，值越大表示和查询的图片相关性越高。由于算法模型不同。
当类目为0~2时，SortExprValues值域范围：0～7.33136443711219e+24。
类目为其他值时，SortExprValues值域范围：0～5.37633353624177e+24。当两个图片完全一样时，这个分值最大

StrAttr3.description_en: The string attribute. The maximum length is 128 characters. This field can be used for filtering during queries and is returned in query results
StrAttr3.description_zh: 字符串类型属性，最多支持128个字符。可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段

StrAttr4.description_en: The string attribute. The maximum length is 128 characters. This field can be used for filtering during queries and is returned in query results
StrAttr4.description_zh: 字符串类型属性，最多支持128个字符。可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段

Code.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:
0: success.
Non-zero: failure
Code.description_zh:
错误码。
0：成功。
非0：失败

Head.description_en: The overview of the search results

DocsReturn.description_en: The number of matched results in the instance

PicInfo.description_en: The information such as category prediction and subject identification results
PicInfo.description_zh: 类目预测、主体识别结果等信息

AllCategories.description_en: The information about all categories supported by the system
AllCategories.description_zh: 系统支持的所有类目信息

CategoryId.description_en:
The category prediction result.
If the user specifies a category in the request, the specified category is used
CategoryId.description_zh:
类目预测结果。
若用户请求中指定了类目，则以请求中为准

Region.description_en:
The subject identification result.
The subject region of the image, in the format of x1,x2,y1,y2, where x1,y1 is the upper-left point and x2,y2 is the lower-right point. If the user specifies a subject region in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh:
主体识别结果。
图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

The subject region of the image, in the format of x1,x2,y1,y2, where x1,y1 is the upper-left point and x2,y2 is the lower-right point. If the user specifies a subject region in the request, the specified region is used

图片的主体区域，格式为x1,x2,y1,y2，其中 x1,y1 是左上角的点，x2，y2是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
